Compute the measures of the shaded angles in the figure above.
question.worked_solution:
The two angles marked in the diagram are vertical. Since vertical angles are congruent, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}6x-{32}^{∘} & =2x+{16}^{∘} \\ 4x-{32}^{∘} & ={16}^{∘} \\ 4x & ={48}^{∘} \\ x & ={12}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

Now that we know $x={12}^{∘},$ we can substitute into one of the expressions to calculate the measure of the angles. Let's substitute into the expression $2x+{16}^{∘}:$

$$
2({12}^{∘})+{16}^{∘}={40}^{∘}
$$

Therefore, both angles have a measure of ${40}^{∘}.$
